verdict.rationale: stagewise documents a 'Multiple workspaces' feature that connects several project folders at once so agents can work across the full stack. Its agents are also described as operating across workspaces, which directly matches the story's core. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how multiple directories share context within a single chat session (limits, per-workspace WORKSPACE.md merging), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can include multiple project directories in a single session for broader context
